THE NEW MEXICO PUBLIC REGULATION COMMISSION



IN THE MATTER OF THE APPLICATION OF                                       )
                                                                          ) Docket No. 25-00082-UT
EL PASO ELECTRIC COMPANY BEFORE FOR REVISION                              )
OF ITS RETAIL ELECTRIC RATES PURSUANT                                     )
                                                                          )
TO ADVICE NOTICE NO. 317




             Stephen Fischmann’s Motion to File Testimony Out of Time

 Pursuant to 1.2.2.12 NMAC Stephen Fischmann requests the Commission to allow him to file

 the Testimony of Joel Hornstein and Mark Ellis on behalf of Pro Se intervenor Stephen

 Fischmann out of time. In support of this Motion Mr. Fischmann states as follows:


    1. Mr. Fischmann and witnesses inadvertently missed the filing deadline because of

        miscommunication over who would make the filing on the E 360 system.

    2. No party is prejudiced by granting this Motion.

    3. Unique and important data and perspectives important to the public interest are presented

        in this testimony.

    4. The positions of the parties are as follows: Support: City of Las Cruces, Dona Ana County,

        CCAE, WRA, Phil Simpson, Dwight Eggers; Do not Oppose: EPE, DoD/FEA, Staff,

        Walmart; Oppose: None.




 Wherefore, for the reasons stated herein, Stephen Fischmann respectfully requests the

 Commission to allow Mr. Fischmann to file the Testimony of Joel Hornstein and Mark Ellis on

 his behalf out of time and for such other relief as is just and reasonable.


 Respectfully submitted this 26th day of October 2026.
 /s/ Stephen Fischmann
